name: io.github.robinvdvleuten/pim-mcp
title: pim-mcp
description: Read your mail and manage your calendar on your own IMAP and CalDAV servers.

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: The directory that holds the account settings, made with `pim-mcp account add`.

config_dir.description: The settings directory on the host.

environmentVariables.name: PIM_MCP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: The account password. A container has no keychain, so this is needed. Only works with a single account.

environmentVariables.name: PIM_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to remove every tool that can change something.
